corrections.LF.6a:
SECURITY (mandatory, integration critic): CI-log messages and traces are untrusted text that can contain tokens. Before anything is stored in a snapshot or a FAIL cell, pass it through the secret-shape redaction A13.7 made mandatory for .env values (same denylist and helper, no second implementation). Add a test that feeds a token-shaped string (e.g. an sk_live_-style key and a JWT) through the ingest and asserts it never reaches the .gmap, dense text or the Engram export.

GITIGNORE SPLIT: LC.9 makes the graph layout dir ignore itself (its own `.gitignore` containing `*`), so `.glia/.gitignore` does not need a line for the gmap cache dir. `.glia/.gitignore` covers only the local, regenerable inputs: `vectors.jsonl`, `docs-snapshot/`, `history-snapshot/`, `test-snapshot/`. Never list `overlay.toml` or `cells.jsonl` there - they are checked in.

GITIGNORE (James, 2026-09-19: "place we git ignore and don't double write"): the layout must never show up in any repo's git status. persist_result writes a self-ignoring `<layout dir>/.gitignore` containing `# written by glia - this directory is regenerated` and `*` on every persist (idempotent, byte-identical content). A `*` in a directory's own .gitignore ignores every file in it, itself included, so the directory disappears from `git status` in quokka, neuropil or any repo without glia ever editing the user's root .gitignore. Everything generated (shards, manifest, cross_stack, parse_cache.bin) lives under that dir. Do NOT ignore the rest of `.glia/`: `.glia/overlay.toml` and `.glia/cells.jsonl` are checked-in inputs (LF). Add a test: persist into a temp dir that is a `git init`ed repo and assert `git status --porcelain` lists nothing under `.glia/graph/` (skip the assertion, not the test, if `git` is absent). Keep the root .gitignore lines for glia's own repo as specced.
